hero.title: Renan Rambul
hero.subtitle: Software Engineer
hero.tagline: I build products end to end, from APIs to fast, accessible interfaces that feel great to use.

about.title: About Me
about.content: I'm a software engineer who has spent the last 6+ years shipping web products end to end. I work across the stack, from API design and data modeling to design systems and accessible UI, and the frontend is where I go deepest. These days I build healthcare SaaS with a U.S.-based team, owning features from the API to the pixel. I care about clean architecture, a good developer experience, and the small details that make a product feel right.

personal.title: Personal
personal.content: I love building things, learning in public, and contributing to open source. When I'm not coding, I'm probably reading or at the gym.

technical.title: Technical
technical.content: React, TypeScript, and Node.js across the stack, going deepest on design systems, accessibility, and performance.

languages.title: Languages
languages.content: Native Portuguese and advanced English. I've been working day-to-day with international teams for years.

tas.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Ship features end to end on a U.S. healthcare SaaS platform, from API endpoints and data-model changes to accessible UI and PDF reporting, across 100+ merged PRs.
Build and maintain the web-component design system that multiple product teams ship on, with accessibility and performance treated as requirements, not nice-to-haves.
Write Playwright integration tests that catch regressions before they reach a release.
Own the private npm release pipeline for shared packages and review frontend PRs for architecture and fidelity to Figma designs.
Improve the team's AI-assisted workflows, including a hierarchical knowledge base that keeps coding agents productive across the codebase.

freelance.title: Frontend Software Engineer
responsibilities: Built the landing pages and application UI for an ed-tech platform, focused on fast loads and clear conversion paths.
Streamlined student and admin workflows, removing manual steps from day-to-day operations.
Established the frontend architecture around React, React Query, and React Hook Form so the codebase stays maintainable as the product grows.
Worked directly with product stakeholders to turn business requirements into shippable, user-centered features.

bymycell.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Built the React dashboards and reports that turn raw genomics lab results into something researchers can actually read.
Connected frontend and backend systems to make lab workflows traceable end to end, with fewer manual handoffs and errors.
Refactored legacy backend modules into a DDD architecture while keeping the old system running, without interrupting lab operations.
Added the unit and integration test suites the codebase was missing.

take.title: Frontend Software Engineer
responsibilities: Built the backoffice that runs a network of smart retail coolers: order management, inventory control, and live operational dashboards.
Helped grow the internal design system, raising component reuse across teams and speeding up feature delivery.
Introduced end-to-end testing with Cypress, catching bugs before deploys instead of after.
Created accessible, interactive data visualizations for day-to-day operational decisions.
Worked directly with international clients, owning features from planning through deployment.

suave.title: Full-stack Developer
responsibilities: Shipped Next.js landing pages for agency clients where load speed and conversion were the whole brief.
Designed and built a multi-tenant link-aggregator platform (React + Express) serving multiple client brands from a single codebase.
Developed custom site features that turned client websites into lead-generation channels.
Ran SEO and performance work that lifted clients' organic visibility.

modularGameStore.title: Modular Game Store
modularGameStore.description: A modern, high-performance micro-frontend e-commerce platform built with Rspack and Module Federation, demonstrating scalable frontend architecture for large distributed teams.

marketPulse.title: Market Pulse
marketPulse.description: A real-time financial market monitoring platform built with Lit, Lit Signals, Rspack, and Module Federation, designed to explore high-performance reactive UIs under streaming data loads.

animavita.title: Animavita
animavita.description: Trigger life-saving alerts, register animals for adoption and find the closest pet friend to adopt. An open-source project with 739+ stars and 318+ forks on GitHub.
